Summary: The belief that the physical body is a trap or tomb (soma sema) for the spirit requiring escape or punishment (e.g. Gnostics, Heavens Gate).
The belief that the body is a divine vessel or chemical laboratory capable of producing salvation through physical processes (e.g. Tantra, Phibionites).
The use of pain, fasting, sleep deprivation, or sensory denial to purify the self (e.g. Essenes, Penitentes).
The use of intoxication, loud music, feasting, or sexual exhaustion to alter consciousness (e.g. Dionysian Mysteries, Rajneesh).
The explicit use of sexual acts as a liturgical technology or magical operation (e.g. OTO, Crowley, Paschal Beverly Randolph).
The conviction that the material world is inherently evil or created by a malevolent demiurge (e.g. Cathars, Manichaeism).
The belief that gods or creators are biological extraterrestrials or advanced engineers (e.g. Raelians, Scientology, Annunaki theories).
The worship or utilization of entropy, disorder, and void as a primal creative force (e.g. Chaos Magic, Anti-Cosmic Satanism).
Focus on an imminent, violent end-of-the-world event that requires preparation or acceleration (e.g. QAnon, Manson Family, Aum Shinrikyo).
Focus on returning to a mythical Golden Age or blood-lineage of the past (e.g. Thule Society, Druids, Völkisch groups).
The spiritual obligation to break social taboos and laws to transcend duality or shock the ego (e.g. Frankists, Aghori, Cainites).
The justification of murder or physical harm as a religious duty or act of love (e.g. Thuggee, Assassins, Solar Temple).
Strict adherence to complex purity codes, dietary restrictions, and micromanagement of daily life (e.g. Opus Dei, Mormonism).
Membership restricted by race, genetic lineage, or family origin (e.g. Ahnenerbe, KKK, Tribes).
Totalitarian devotion to a single living leader who dictates reality for the group (e.g. Peoples Temple, Synanon).
The pursuit of truth through geometry, science, reason, or study (e.g. Illuminati, Pythagoreans).
The pursuit of truth through drug-induced or trance-based hallucinations (e.g. Eleusinian Mysteries, Ayahuasca circles).
Centrality of a Goddess figure, womb symbolism, or female priesthood (e.g. Cybele, Dianic Wicca).
Centrality of the Sun, the Phallus, or the Father-King as the axis of order (e.g. Mithras, Right-Hand Path Tantra).
